releaseNotes:
float 0.6.7

• 修复更新重启后可能出现两个 Dock 图标的问题。
• 重复打开时回到现有窗口，避免再次创建字幕窗口、加载模型或启动录音任务。
• 保留已有设置与下载资源。

• Fixed duplicate Dock icons after an update restart.
• Opening float again returns to the existing window without starting a second caption, model or audio session.
• Existing preferences and downloaded resources are preserved.
